answers.core: Yes. World partitioning affects engine architecture, resource management, and performance. Leaving it as an add-on risks fragmentation, inconsistent quality, duplication of effort, and reduced adoption. Core integration guarantees a robust foundation for large-scale 3D projects in Godot 5.
answers.workaround: Partial solutions exist through community plugins or custom scripts, but implementing fully-featured world partitioning, dynamic LOD streaming, and asset/physics streaming manually is highly complex and inefficient. Core integration ensures performance, stability, and usability for large-scale projects.

title: Integrated Scene Streaming and LOD System for High-End 3D Worlds
